entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: A plane with a verdant jungle continent where all peoples seek the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: The ancient golden city in Ixalan's jungle where the Immortal Sun lies secure.

entities.name: The Immortal Sun
entities.description: An artifact of mythic power promising boundless wealth, strength of empire, command over nature and eternal life.

entities.name: The Sun Empire
entities.description: The humans of Ixalan whose ancient ruins lie in the jungle.

entities.name: The Brazen Coalition
entities.description: Treasure-hungry pirates who arrived on Ixalan as outsiders.

entities.name: The Legion of Dusk
entities.description: A sinister fleet of vampires seeking to conquer Ixalan.

events.summary: The Immortal Sun passes from legend to reality and all the peoples of Ixalan seek its power.
events.quote: now legend has become reality, and all the peoples of Ixalan seek the Immortal Sun and the power it promises.

events.summary: The pirates of the Brazen Coalition and then the Legion of Dusk disrupt the balance between the merfolk and humans.
events.quote: But outsiders—first the treasure-hungry pirates of the Brazen Coalition and now the sinister fleets of the Legion of Dusk—have disrupted that delicate balance of power.

events.summary: As the Legion of Dusk seeks to conquer Ixalan, all four peoples search desperately for the golden city.
events.quote: And as the Legion of Dusk seeks to conquer Ixalan, all four peoples are catapulted into a desperate search for the golden city and the treasure it holds.

relations.quote: Secure in the ancient golden city of Orazca, the Immortal Sun is an artifact of mythic power

relations.note: They have shared the continent for ages, sometimes warring, sometimes in uneasy peace.
relations.quote: sometimes warring, sometimes in an uneasy peace.
